ABOUT FUBAR LABS

Fair Use Building and Research Labs brings makers, hackers, and tinkerers together to collaborate and share ideas and knowledge.

501(c)(3) non-profit, run by volunteers

1510B Jersey Ave, North Brunswick, NJ

Slide 4 notes: FUBAR stands for Fair Use Building and Research. Community-run, volunteer-led, no corporate or institutional affiliation.
